	font-size: 20px;
	text-align: center;
	color: #D7DEE9; /* FONT COLOR */
	line-height: 1.6em;
	background-color: #2F2F31; /* BACKGROUND COLOR -- "#333B45" is original */
}
.cloze, .cloze b, .cloze u, .cloze i { font-weight: bold; color: MediumSeaGreen !important;}
/* --- Bar timer --- */
.tbar{
  position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 1;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  padding: 6px 8px; margin: 0 0 12px 0;
  background: rgba(16,24,40,.25); border: 1px solid rgba(34,50,77,.65);
  border-radius: 12px; backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
}
.ttrack{
  flex: 1 1 auto; height: 8px; border-radius: 999px;
  background: #102035; border: 1px solid #22324d; overflow: hidden;
}
.tfill{
  height: 100%; width: 100%; background: #27d3ff; /* JS updates color */
  transform-origin: left center;
}
.tleft{
  font-size: 12px; color: #A6ABB9; line-height: 1;
  white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  min-width: 52px; text-align: right; /* keeps it on one line */
}
.tbar.done .tleft{ color:#CC5B5B }
/* Optional: stop your fixed .tags from intercepting touches/scroll */
.tags{ pointer-events: none; }
/* --- END Bar timer --- */
#extra, #extra i { font-size: 15px; color:#D7DEE9; font-style: italic; }
#list { color: #A6ABB9; font-size: 10px; width: 100%; text-align: center; }
.tags { color: #A6ABB9; opacity: 0; font-size: 10px; background-color: ; width: 100%; height: ; text-align: center; text-transform: uppercase; position: fixed; padding: 0px; top:0;  right: 0;}
/* add what's within quotes if you want to see tags upon hovering: ".tags:hover { opacity: 1; position: fixed;}" */
img { display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: none; margin-left: auto; margin: 10px auto 10px auto;}
img:active { width: 100%; }
tr {font-size: 12px; }
/* CHANGE COLOR ACCENTS HERE */
b { color: #C695C6 !important; }
u { text-decoration: none; color: #5EB3B3;}
i  { color: IndianRed; }
a { color: LightBlue !important; text-decoration: none; font-size: 14px; font-style: normal;  }
::-webkit-scrollbar {
    /*display: none;   remove scrollbar space */
    background: #fff;   /* optional: just make scrollbar invisible */
    width: 0px; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #bbb; }
/* .mobile for all mobile devices */
.mobile .card { color: #D7DEE9; font-size: ; font-weight: ; background-color: #2F2F31; }
.iphone .card img {max-width: 100%; max-height: none;}
.mobile .card img:active { width: inherit; max-height: none;}
/* add what's within quotes if you want to see tags upon hovering: ".mobile .tags:hover { opacity: 1; position: relative;}" */
/* iPhone-only timer */
.tbar { display: none; }
.iphone .tbar { display: flex; }
/* Hide audio controls everywhere except iPhone */
.replay-button,
.replaybutton,
.soundLink {
  display: none !important;
}
.iphone .replay-button,
.iphone .replaybutton,
.iphone .soundLink {
  display: inline-flex !important;
}

(function(){
  function isIPhone(){
    return document.documentElement.classList.contains("iphone") ||
           (document.body && document.body.classList.contains("iphone"));
  }
  if (!isIPhone()) return;
  function playIPhoneAudioOnce(){
    var btn = document.querySelector(".replay-button, .replaybutton, .soundLink");
    if (!btn || btn.dataset.iphoneAutoplayDone) return;
    btn.dataset.iphoneAutoplayDone = "1";
    btn.click();
  }
  playIPhoneAudioOnce();
  setTimeout(playIPhoneAudioOnce, 50);
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){
    playIPhoneAudioOnce();
  });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      playIPhoneAudioOnce();
    });
  }
})();

/* Re-entrant bar timer for Anki (desktop, AnkiMobile, AnkiDroid)
   - Attaches on every card load (no global guard)
   - Starts once per element via data flag
   - Works even when Anki swaps DOM without reloading the page
*/
(function(){
  function isIPhone(){
    return document.documentElement.classList.contains("iphone") ||
           (document.body && document.body.classList.contains("iphone"));
  }
  if (!isIPhone()) return;
  function colorFor(p){
    var hStart = 170, hEnd = 0, h = hEnd + (hStart - hEnd) * p;
    return "hsl(" + h + ",95%,55%)";
  }
  function pad2(n){ return (n<10? "0":"") + n }
  function startTimerOn(el){
    if (!el || el.hasAttribute("data-bar-started")) return;
    el.setAttribute("data-bar-started","1");
    var secs = parseFloat(el.getAttribute("data-seconds")||"12");
    if (!(secs>0)) secs = 1;
    var fill  = el.querySelector(".tfill");
    var txt   = el.querySelector(".tleft");
    if (!fill || !txt) return;
    var durMs = secs*1000, start = performance.now();
    function tick(t){
      var left = Math.max(0, durMs - (t - start));
      var frac = left / durMs;
      fill.style.width = (frac*100).toFixed(3) + "%";
      fill.style.background = colorFor(frac);
      var s = Math.ceil(left/1000), mm = Math.floor(s/60), ss = s%60;
      txt.textContent = mm ? (mm + ":" + pad2(ss)) : (s + "s");
      if (left>0) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      else el.classList.add("done");
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  function scanAndStart(){
    var bars = document.querySelectorAll(".tbar");
    for (var i=0;i<bars.length;i++) startTimerOn(bars[i]);
  }
  // Run now (script is after .tbar HTML)
  scanAndStart();
  // Also run whenever Anki swaps/rebuilds the DOM
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){ scanAndStart(); });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      scanAndStart();
    });
  }
})();

What is the typical treatment pathway for symptomatic Budd-Chiari syndrome?
Initial attempts may include angioplasty or stenting of stenoses/webs, but often requires TIPS creation for definitive decompression if significant portal hypertension exists.
Explanation: Addressing the outflow obstruction is key. Simple obstructions might respond to angioplasty/stenting, but diffuse disease or severe portal hypertension often necessitates creating a shunt (TIPS).

      if (left > 0) {
        requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      } else {
        el.classList.add("done");
      }
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  function scanAndStart(){
    var bars = document.querySelectorAll(".tbar");
    for (var i = 0; i < bars.length; i++) startTimerOn(bars[i]);
  }
  scanAndStart();

      scanAndStart();
    });

})();

    var bodyCls = (document.body && document.body.className) || "";

    return /\biphone\b|\bipad\b/.test(cls);
  }
  if (!isIOSClient()) return;
  function colorFor(p){
    var hStart = 170, hEnd = 0, h = hEnd + (hStart - hEnd) * p;
    return "hsl(" + h + ",95%,55%)";
  }
  function pad2(n){ return (n<10 ? "0" : "") + n; }
  function startTimerOn(el){
    if (!el || el.hasAttribute("data-bar-started")) return;
    el.setAttribute("data-bar-started","1");
    var secs = parseFloat(el.getAttribute("data-seconds") || "12");
    if (!(secs > 0)) secs = 1;
    var fill = el.querySelector(".tfill");
    var txt = el.querySelector(".tleft");
    if (!fill || !txt) return;
    var durMs = secs * 1000;
    var start = performance.now();
    function tick(t){
      var left = Math.max(0, durMs - (t - start));
      var frac = left / durMs;
      fill.style.width = (frac * 100).toFixed(3) + "%";
      fill.style.background = colorFor(frac);
      var s = Math.ceil(left / 1000);
      var mm = Math.floor(s / 60);
      var ss = s % 60;
      txt.textContent = mm ? (mm + ":" + pad2(ss)) : (s + "s");
      if (left > 0) {

      }
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  function scanAndStart(){
    var bars = document.querySelectorAll(".tbar");
    for (var i = 0; i < bars.length; i++) startTimerOn(bars[i]);
  }
  scanAndStart();
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){
    scanAndStart();
  });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {

      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      scanAndStart();
    });
  }
})();

})();

  function colorFor(p){
    var hStart = 170, hEnd = 0, h = hEnd + (hStart - hEnd) * p;
    return "hsl(" + h + ",95%,55%)";
  }
  function pad2(n){ return (n<10 ? "0" : "") + n; }
  function startTimerOn(el){
    if (!el || el.hasAttribute("data-bar-started")) return;

    if (!(secs > 0)) secs = 1;
    var fill = el.querySelector(".tfill");
    var txt = el.querySelector(".tleft");
    if (!fill || !txt) return;
    var durMs = secs * 1000;
    var start = performance.now();

      var frac = left / durMs;

      fill.style.background = colorFor(frac);
      var s = Math.ceil(left / 1000);
      var mm = Math.floor(s / 60);
      var ss = s % 60;
      txt.textContent = mm ? (mm + ":" + pad2(ss)) : (s + "s");
      if (left > 0) {
        requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      } else {
        el.classList.add("done");
      }
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      scanAndStart();
    });
  }
})();

(function(){
  function isIOSClient(){
    var htmlCls = (document.documentElement && document.documentElement.className) || "";
    var bodyCls = (document.body && document.body.className) || "";
    var cls = (htmlCls + " " + bodyCls).toLowerCase();
    return /\biphone\b|\bipad\b/.test(cls);
  }
  if (!isIOSClient()) return;
  function colorFor(p){
    var hStart = 170, hEnd = 0, h = hEnd + (hStart - hEnd) * p;
    return "hsl(" + h + ",95%,55%)";
  }
  function pad2(n){ return (n<10 ? "0" : "") + n; }
  function startTimerOn(el){
    if (!el || el.hasAttribute("data-bar-started")) return;
    el.setAttribute("data-bar-started","1");
    var secs = parseFloat(el.getAttribute("data-seconds") || "12");
    if (!(secs > 0)) secs = 1;
    var fill = el.querySelector(".tfill");
    var txt = el.querySelector(".tleft");
    if (!fill || !txt) return;
    var durMs = secs * 1000;
    var start = performance.now();
    function tick(t){
      var left = Math.max(0, durMs - (t - start));
      var frac = left / durMs;
      fill.style.width = (frac * 100).toFixed(3) + "%";
      fill.style.background = colorFor(frac);
      var s = Math.ceil(left / 1000);
      var mm = Math.floor(s / 60);
      var ss = s % 60;
      txt.textContent = mm ? (mm + ":" + pad2(ss)) : (s + "s");
      if (left > 0) {
        requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      } else {
        el.classList.add("done");
      }
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  function scanAndStart(){
    var bars = document.querySelectorAll(".tbar");
    for (var i = 0; i < bars.length; i++) startTimerOn(bars[i]);
  }
  scanAndStart();
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){
    scanAndStart();
  });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      scanAndStart();
    });
  }
})();

try {
  const src = document.getElementById('images-src');
  const images = src ? src.children : [];
  let randomIdx = Math.floor(Math.random() * (images.length || 1));
  function show_img(){
    const holder = document.getElementById('front');
    if (!holder || images.length === 0) return;
    holder.innerHTML = images[randomIdx].outerHTML;
  }
  function next_img(){
    if (images.length <= 1) return;
    randomIdx = (randomIdx + 1) % images.length;
    show_img();
  }
  // Hide the button if there's only one image
  if (images.length <= 1) {
    const btn = document.getElementById('btn');
    if (btn) btn.style.display = 'none';
  }
  show_img();
  // Add the key listener once per card render
  if (!document.body.hasAttribute('img-rand-listener')) {
    document.addEventListener('keyup', function(event){
      const k = event.key || event.keyCode;
      if (k === 'n' || k === 'N') next_img();
    });
    document.body.setAttribute('img-rand-listener', 'true');
  }
} catch (error) {
  const c = document.getElementById('console');
  if (c) c.textContent = error;
}

try {
  const src = document.getElementById('images-src');
  const images = src ? src.children : [];
  let randomIdx = Math.floor(Math.random() * (images.length || 1));
  function show_img(){
    const holder = document.getElementById('front');
    if (!holder || images.length === 0) return;
    holder.innerHTML = images[randomIdx].outerHTML;
  }
  function next_img(){
    if (images.length <= 1) return;
    randomIdx = (randomIdx + 1) % images.length;
    show_img();
  }
  // Hide the button if there's only one image
  if (images.length <= 1) {
    const btn = document.getElementById('btn');
    if (btn) btn.style.display = 'none';
  }
  show_img();
  // Add the key listener once per card render
  if (!document.body.hasAttribute('img-rand-listener')) {
    document.addEventListener('keyup', function(event){
      const k = event.key || event.keyCode;
      if (k === 'n' || k === 'N') next_img();
    });
    document.body.setAttribute('img-rand-listener', 'true');
  }
} catch (error) {
  const c = document.getElementById('console');
  if (c) c.textContent = error;
}

(function(){
  function isIOSClient(){
    var htmlCls = (document.documentElement && document.documentElement.className) || "";
    var bodyCls = (document.body && document.body.className) || "";
    var cls = (htmlCls + " " + bodyCls).toLowerCase();
    return /\biphone\b|\bipad\b/.test(cls);
  }
  if (!isIOSClient()) return;
  function colorFor(p){
    var hStart = 170, hEnd = 0, h = hEnd + (hStart - hEnd) * p;
    return "hsl(" + h + ",95%,55%)";
  }
  function pad2(n){ return (n<10 ? "0" : "") + n; }
  function startTimerOn(el){
    if (!el || el.hasAttribute("data-bar-started")) return;
    el.setAttribute("data-bar-started","1");
    var secs = parseFloat(el.getAttribute("data-seconds") || "12");
    if (!(secs > 0)) secs = 1;
    var fill = el.querySelector(".tfill");
    var txt = el.querySelector(".tleft");
    if (!fill || !txt) return;
    var durMs = secs * 1000;
    var start = performance.now();
    function tick(t){
      var left = Math.max(0, durMs - (t - start));
      var frac = left / durMs;
      fill.style.width = (frac * 100).toFixed(3) + "%";
      fill.style.background = colorFor(frac);
      var s = Math.ceil(left / 1000);
      var mm = Math.floor(s / 60);
      var ss = s % 60;
      txt.textContent = mm ? (mm + ":" + pad2(ss)) : (s + "s");
      if (left > 0) {
        requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      } else {
        el.classList.add("done");
      }
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  function scanAndStart(){
    var bars = document.querySelectorAll(".tbar");
    for (var i = 0; i < bars.length; i++) startTimerOn(bars[i]);
  }
  scanAndStart();
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){
    scanAndStart();
  });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      scanAndStart();
    });
  }
})();

(function(){
  function isIPhone(){
    return document.documentElement.classList.contains("iphone") ||
           (document.body && document.body.classList.contains("iphone"));
  }
  if (!isIPhone()) return;
  function colorFor(p){
    var hStart = 170, hEnd = 0, h = hEnd + (hStart - hEnd) * p;
    return "hsl(" + h + ",95%,55%)";
  }

  function startTimerOn(el){

    el.setAttribute("data-bar-started","1");
    var secs = parseFloat(el.getAttribute("data-seconds")||"12");
    if (!(secs>0)) secs = 1;
    var fill  = el.querySelector(".tfill");
    var txt   = el.querySelector(".tleft");
    if (!fill || !txt) return;
    var durMs = secs*1000, start = performance.now();
    function tick(t){
      var left = Math.max(0, durMs - (t - start));
      var frac = left / durMs;
      fill.style.width = (frac*100).toFixed(3) + "%";
      fill.style.background = colorFor(frac);
      var s = Math.ceil(left/1000), mm = Math.floor(s/60), ss = s%60;
      txt.textContent = mm ? (mm + ":" + pad2(ss)) : (s + "s");
      if (left>0) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      else el.classList.add("done");
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  function scanAndStart(){
    var bars = document.querySelectorAll(".tbar");
    for (var i=0;i<bars.length;i++) startTimerOn(bars[i]);
  }
  // Run now (script is after .tbar HTML)
  scanAndStart();
  // Also run whenever Anki swaps/rebuilds the DOM
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){ scanAndStart(); });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      scanAndStart();
    });
  }
})();

    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      playIPhoneAudioOnce();
    });
  }
})();

What are the units for acoustic impedance?
Rayls, or kilograms per meter squared per second. Because it is the product of density ( kg/m^3 ) and speed (m/s), the SI units for acoustic impedance are kilograms per meter squared per second.

    if (!holder || images.length === 0) return;
    holder.innerHTML = images[randomIdx].outerHTML;
  }
  function next_img(){
    if (images.length <= 1) return;
    randomIdx = (randomIdx + 1) % images.length;
    show_img();
  }
  // Hide the button if there's only one image
  if (images.length <= 1) {
    const btn = document.getElementById('btn');
    if (btn) btn.style.display = 'none';
  }
  show_img();
  // Add the key listener once per card render
  if (!document.body.hasAttribute('img-rand-listener')) {
    document.addEventListener('keyup', function(event){
      const k = event.key || event.keyCode;
      if (k === 'n' || k === 'N') next_img();
    });
    document.body.setAttribute('img-rand-listener', 'true');
  }
} catch (error) {
  const c = document.getElementById('console');
  if (c) c.textContent = error;
}

(function(){
  function isIOSClient(){
    var htmlCls = (document.documentElement && document.documentElement.className) || "";
    var bodyCls = (document.body && document.body.className) || "";
    var cls = (htmlCls + " " + bodyCls).toLowerCase();
    return /\biphone\b|\bipad\b/.test(cls);
  }
  if (!isIOSClient()) return;
  function colorFor(p){
    var hStart = 170, hEnd = 0, h = hEnd + (hStart - hEnd) * p;
    return "hsl(" + h + ",95%,55%)";
  }
  function pad2(n){ return (n<10 ? "0" : "") + n; }
  function startTimerOn(el){
    if (!el || el.hasAttribute("data-bar-started")) return;
    el.setAttribute("data-bar-started","1");
    var secs = parseFloat(el.getAttribute("data-seconds") || "12");
    if (!(secs > 0)) secs = 1;
    var fill = el.querySelector(".tfill");
    var txt = el.querySelector(".tleft");
    if (!fill || !txt) return;
    var durMs = secs * 1000;
    var start = performance.now();
    function tick(t){
      var left = Math.max(0, durMs - (t - start));
      var frac = left / durMs;
      fill.style.width = (frac * 100).toFixed(3) + "%";
      fill.style.background = colorFor(frac);
      var s = Math.ceil(left / 1000);
      var mm = Math.floor(s / 60);
      var ss = s % 60;
      txt.textContent = mm ? (mm + ":" + pad2(ss)) : (s + "s");
      if (left > 0) {
        requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      } else {
        el.classList.add("done");
      }
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  function scanAndStart(){
    var bars = document.querySelectorAll(".tbar");
    for (var i = 0; i < bars.length; i++) startTimerOn(bars[i]);
  }
  scanAndStart();
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){
    scanAndStart();
  });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      scanAndStart();
    });
  }
})();

/* Re-entrant bar timer for Anki (desktop, AnkiMobile, AnkiDroid)
   - Attaches on every card load (no global guard)
   - Starts once per element via data flag
   - Works even when Anki swaps DOM without reloading the page

(function(){
  function isIPhone(){
    return document.documentElement.classList.contains("iphone") ||
           (document.body && document.body.classList.contains("iphone"));
  }
  if (!isIPhone()) return;
  function colorFor(p){
    var hStart = 170, hEnd = 0, h = hEnd + (hStart - hEnd) * p;
    return "hsl(" + h + ",95%,55%)";
  }
  function pad2(n){ return (n<10? "0":"") + n }
  function startTimerOn(el){
    if (!el || el.hasAttribute("data-bar-started")) return;
    el.setAttribute("data-bar-started","1");

    if (!(secs>0)) secs = 1;
    var fill  = el.querySelector(".tfill");
    var txt   = el.querySelector(".tleft");
    if (!fill || !txt) return;
    var durMs = secs*1000, start = performance.now();
    function tick(t){
      var left = Math.max(0, durMs - (t - start));
      var frac = left / durMs;
      fill.style.width = (frac*100).toFixed(3) + "%";
      fill.style.background = colorFor(frac);
      var s = Math.ceil(left/1000), mm = Math.floor(s/60), ss = s%60;
      txt.textContent = mm ? (mm + ":" + pad2(ss)) : (s + "s");
      if (left>0) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      else el.classList.add("done");
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  function scanAndStart(){
    var bars = document.querySelectorAll(".tbar");
    for (var i=0;i<bars.length;i++) startTimerOn(bars[i]);
  }
  // Run now (script is after .tbar HTML)
  scanAndStart();
  // Also run whenever Anki swaps/rebuilds the DOM
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){ scanAndStart(); });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      scanAndStart();
    });
  }
})();

(function(){
  function isIPhone(){
    return document.documentElement.classList.contains("iphone") ||
           (document.body && document.body.classList.contains("iphone"));
  }
  if (!isIPhone()) return;
  function playIPhoneAudioOnce(){
    var btn = document.querySelector(".replay-button, .replaybutton, .soundLink");
    if (!btn || btn.dataset.iphoneAutoplayDone) return;
    btn.dataset.iphoneAutoplayDone = "1";
    btn.click();
  }
  playIPhoneAudioOnce();
  setTimeout(playIPhoneAudioOnce, 50);
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){
    playIPhoneAudioOnce();
  });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      playIPhoneAudioOnce();
    });
  }
})();

  function isIOSClient(){

    var bodyCls = (document.body && document.body.className) || "";
    var cls = (htmlCls + " " + bodyCls).toLowerCase();
    return /\biphone\b|\bipad\b/.test(cls);
  }
  if (!isIOSClient()) return;
  function colorFor(p){
    var hStart = 170, hEnd = 0, h = hEnd + (hStart - hEnd) * p;
    return "hsl(" + h + ",95%,55%)";
  }
  function pad2(n){ return (n<10 ? "0" : "") + n; }
  function startTimerOn(el){
    if (!el || el.hasAttribute("data-bar-started")) return;
    el.setAttribute("data-bar-started","1");
    var secs = parseFloat(el.getAttribute("data-seconds") || "12");
    if (!(secs > 0)) secs = 1;
    var fill = el.querySelector(".tfill");
    var txt = el.querySelector(".tleft");
    if (!fill || !txt) return;
    var durMs = secs * 1000;
    var start = performance.now();
    function tick(t){
      var left = Math.max(0, durMs - (t - start));
      var frac = left / durMs;
      fill.style.width = (frac * 100).toFixed(3) + "%";
      fill.style.background = colorFor(frac);
      var s = Math.ceil(left / 1000);
      var mm = Math.floor(s / 60);
      var ss = s % 60;
      txt.textContent = mm ? (mm + ":" + pad2(ss)) : (s + "s");
      if (left > 0) {
        requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      } else {
        el.classList.add("done");
      }
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  function scanAndStart(){
    var bars = document.querySelectorAll(".tbar");
    for (var i = 0; i < bars.length; i++) startTimerOn(bars[i]);
  }
  scanAndStart();
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){
    scanAndStart();
  });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      scanAndStart();
    });
  }
})();

(function(){
  function isIOSClient(){
    var htmlCls = (document.documentElement && document.documentElement.className) || "";
    var bodyCls = (document.body && document.body.className) || "";
    var cls = (htmlCls + " " + bodyCls).toLowerCase();
    return /\biphone\b|\bipad\b/.test(cls);
  }
  if (!isIOSClient()) return;
  function colorFor(p){
    var hStart = 170, hEnd = 0, h = hEnd + (hStart - hEnd) * p;
    return "hsl(" + h + ",95%,55%)";
  }
  function pad2(n){ return (n<10 ? "0" : "") + n; }
  function startTimerOn(el){
    if (!el || el.hasAttribute("data-bar-started")) return;
    el.setAttribute("data-bar-started","1");
    var secs = parseFloat(el.getAttribute("data-seconds") || "12");
    if (!(secs > 0)) secs = 1;
    var fill = el.querySelector(".tfill");
    var txt = el.querySelector(".tleft");
    if (!fill || !txt) return;
    var durMs = secs * 1000;
    var start = performance.now();
    function tick(t){
      var left = Math.max(0, durMs - (t - start));
      var frac = left / durMs;
      fill.style.width = (frac * 100).toFixed(3) + "%";
      fill.style.background = colorFor(frac);
      var s = Math.ceil(left / 1000);
      var mm = Math.floor(s / 60);
      var ss = s % 60;
      txt.textContent = mm ? (mm + ":" + pad2(ss)) : (s + "s");
      if (left > 0) {
        requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      } else {
        el.classList.add("done");
      }
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  function scanAndStart(){
    var bars = document.querySelectorAll(".tbar");
    for (var i = 0; i < bars.length; i++) startTimerOn(bars[i]);
  }
  scanAndStart();
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){
    scanAndStart();
  });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      scanAndStart();
    });
  }
})();

try {
  const src = document.getElementById('images-src');
  const images = src ? src.children : [];
  let randomIdx = Math.floor(Math.random() * (images.length || 1));
  function show_img(){
    const holder = document.getElementById('front');
    if (!holder || images.length === 0) return;
    holder.innerHTML = images[randomIdx].outerHTML;
  }
  function next_img(){
    if (images.length <= 1) return;
    randomIdx = (randomIdx + 1) % images.length;
    show_img();
  }
  // Hide the button if there's only one image
  if (images.length <= 1) {
    const btn = document.getElementById('btn');
    if (btn) btn.style.display = 'none';
  }
  show_img();
  // Add the key listener once per card render
  if (!document.body.hasAttribute('img-rand-listener')) {
    document.addEventListener('keyup', function(event){
      const k = event.key || event.keyCode;
      if (k === 'n' || k === 'N') next_img();
    });
    document.body.setAttribute('img-rand-listener', 'true');
  }
} catch (error) {
  const c = document.getElementById('console');
  if (c) c.textContent = error;
}

    return /\biphone\b|\bipad\b/.test(cls);
  }
  if (!isIOSClient()) return;
  function colorFor(p){
    var hStart = 170, hEnd = 0, h = hEnd + (hStart - hEnd) * p;
    return "hsl(" + h + ",95%,55%)";
  }
  function pad2(n){ return (n<10 ? "0" : "") + n; }
  function startTimerOn(el){
    if (!el || el.hasAttribute("data-bar-started")) return;
    el.setAttribute("data-bar-started","1");
    var secs = parseFloat(el.getAttribute("data-seconds") || "12");
    if (!(secs > 0)) secs = 1;
    var fill = el.querySelector(".tfill");
    var txt = el.querySelector(".tleft");
    if (!fill || !txt) return;
    var durMs = secs * 1000;
    var start = performance.now();
    function tick(t){
      var left = Math.max(0, durMs - (t - start));
      var frac = left / durMs;
      fill.style.width = (frac * 100).toFixed(3) + "%";
      fill.style.background = colorFor(frac);
      var s = Math.ceil(left / 1000);
      var mm = Math.floor(s / 60);
      var ss = s % 60;

      if (left > 0) {
        requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      } else {
        el.classList.add("done");
      }
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

    var bars = document.querySelectorAll(".tbar");
    for (var i = 0; i < bars.length; i++) startTimerOn(bars[i]);

      scanAndStart();

})();

(function(){
  function isIPhone(){
    return document.documentElement.classList.contains("iphone") ||
           (document.body && document.body.classList.contains("iphone"));
  }
  if (!isIPhone()) return;
  function playIPhoneAudioOnce(){
    var btn = document.querySelector(".replay-button, .replaybutton, .soundLink");
    if (!btn || btn.dataset.iphoneAutoplayDone) return;
    btn.dataset.iphoneAutoplayDone = "1";
    btn.click();
  }
  playIPhoneAudioOnce();
  setTimeout(playIPhoneAudioOnce, 50);
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){
    playIPhoneAudioOnce();
  });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      playIPhoneAudioOnce();
    });
  }
})();

/* Re-entrant bar timer for Anki (desktop, AnkiMobile, AnkiDroid)
   - Attaches on every card load (no global guard)
   - Starts once per element via data flag
   - Works even when Anki swaps DOM without reloading the page
*/
(function(){
  function isIPhone(){
    return document.documentElement.classList.contains("iphone") ||
           (document.body && document.body.classList.contains("iphone"));
  }
  if (!isIPhone()) return;
  function colorFor(p){
    var hStart = 170, hEnd = 0, h = hEnd + (hStart - hEnd) * p;
    return "hsl(" + h + ",95%,55%)";
  }
  function pad2(n){ return (n<10? "0":"") + n }
  function startTimerOn(el){
    if (!el || el.hasAttribute("data-bar-started")) return;
    el.setAttribute("data-bar-started","1");
    var secs = parseFloat(el.getAttribute("data-seconds")||"12");
    if (!(secs>0)) secs = 1;
    var fill  = el.querySelector(".tfill");
    var txt   = el.querySelector(".tleft");
    if (!fill || !txt) return;
    var durMs = secs*1000, start = performance.now();
    function tick(t){
      var left = Math.max(0, durMs - (t - start));
      var frac = left / durMs;
      fill.style.width = (frac*100).toFixed(3) + "%";
      fill.style.background = colorFor(frac);
      var s = Math.ceil(left/1000), mm = Math.floor(s/60), ss = s%60;
      txt.textContent = mm ? (mm + ":" + pad2(ss)) : (s + "s");
      if (left>0) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      else el.classList.add("done");
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  function scanAndStart(){
    var bars = document.querySelectorAll(".tbar");
    for (var i=0;i<bars.length;i++) startTimerOn(bars[i]);
  }
  // Run now (script is after .tbar HTML)
  scanAndStart();
  // Also run whenever Anki swaps/rebuilds the DOM
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){ scanAndStart(); });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      scanAndStart();
    });
  }
})();

(function(){
  function isIPhone(){
    return document.documentElement.classList.contains("iphone") ||
           (document.body && document.body.classList.contains("iphone"));
  }
  if (!isIPhone()) return;
  function playIPhoneAudioOnce(){
    var btn = document.querySelector(".replay-button, .replaybutton, .soundLink");
    if (!btn || btn.dataset.iphoneAutoplayDone) return;
    btn.dataset.iphoneAutoplayDone = "1";
    btn.click();
  }
  playIPhoneAudioOnce();
  setTimeout(playIPhoneAudioOnce, 50);
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){
    playIPhoneAudioOnce();
  });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      playIPhoneAudioOnce();
    });
  }
})();

    var hStart = 170, hEnd = 0, h = hEnd + (hStart - hEnd) * p;
    return "hsl(" + h + ",95%,55%)";
  }
  function pad2(n){ return (n<10 ? "0" : "") + n; }
  function startTimerOn(el){
    if (!el || el.hasAttribute("data-bar-started")) return;
    el.setAttribute("data-bar-started","1");
    var secs = parseFloat(el.getAttribute("data-seconds") || "12");
    if (!(secs > 0)) secs = 1;
    var fill = el.querySelector(".tfill");
    var txt = el.querySelector(".tleft");
    if (!fill || !txt) return;

      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      scanAndStart();
    });
  }
})();

/* Re-entrant bar timer for Anki (desktop, AnkiMobile, AnkiDroid)
   - Attaches on every card load (no global guard)
   - Starts once per element via data flag
   - Works even when Anki swaps DOM without reloading the page

(function(){
  function isIPhone(){
    return document.documentElement.classList.contains("iphone") ||
           (document.body && document.body.classList.contains("iphone"));
  }
  if (!isIPhone()) return;
  function colorFor(p){
    var hStart = 170, hEnd = 0, h = hEnd + (hStart - hEnd) * p;
    return "hsl(" + h + ",95%,55%)";
  }
  function pad2(n){ return (n<10? "0":"") + n }
  function startTimerOn(el){
    if (!el || el.hasAttribute("data-bar-started")) return;
    el.setAttribute("data-bar-started","1");
    var secs = parseFloat(el.getAttribute("data-seconds")||"12");
    if (!(secs>0)) secs = 1;
    var fill  = el.querySelector(".tfill");
    var txt   = el.querySelector(".tleft");
    if (!fill || !txt) return;
    var durMs = secs*1000, start = performance.now();
    function tick(t){
      var left = Math.max(0, durMs - (t - start));
      var frac = left / durMs;
      fill.style.width = (frac*100).toFixed(3) + "%";
      fill.style.background = colorFor(frac);
      var s = Math.ceil(left/1000), mm = Math.floor(s/60), ss = s%60;
      txt.textContent = mm ? (mm + ":" + pad2(ss)) : (s + "s");
      if (left>0) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      else el.classList.add("done");
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  function scanAndStart(){
    var bars = document.querySelectorAll(".tbar");
    for (var i=0;i<bars.length;i++) startTimerOn(bars[i]);
  }
  // Run now (script is after .tbar HTML)
  scanAndStart();
  // Also run whenever Anki swaps/rebuilds the DOM
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){ scanAndStart(); });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      scanAndStart();
    });
  }
})();

(function(){
  function isIPhone(){
    return document.documentElement.classList.contains("iphone") ||
           (document.body && document.body.classList.contains("iphone"));

  if (!isIPhone()) return;
  function playIPhoneAudioOnce(){

    btn.dataset.iphoneAutoplayDone = "1";

    playIPhoneAudioOnce();
  });
  if (document.body){

  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      playIPhoneAudioOnce();
    });
  }
})();

/* Re-entrant bar timer for Anki (desktop, AnkiMobile, AnkiDroid)
   - Attaches on every card load (no global guard)
   - Starts once per element via data flag
   - Works even when Anki swaps DOM without reloading the page
*/
(function(){
  function isIPhone(){
    return document.documentElement.classList.contains("iphone") ||
           (document.body && document.body.classList.contains("iphone"));
  }
  if (!isIPhone()) return;
  function colorFor(p){
    var hStart = 170, hEnd = 0, h = hEnd + (hStart - hEnd) * p;
    return "hsl(" + h + ",95%,55%)";
  }
  function pad2(n){ return (n<10? "0":"") + n }
  function startTimerOn(el){
    if (!el || el.hasAttribute("data-bar-started")) return;
    el.setAttribute("data-bar-started","1");
    var secs = parseFloat(el.getAttribute("data-seconds")||"12");
    if (!(secs>0)) secs = 1;
    var fill  = el.querySelector(".tfill");
    var txt   = el.querySelector(".tleft");
    if (!fill || !txt) return;
    var durMs = secs*1000, start = performance.now();
    function tick(t){
      var left = Math.max(0, durMs - (t - start));
      var frac = left / durMs;
      fill.style.width = (frac*100).toFixed(3) + "%";
      fill.style.background = colorFor(frac);
      var s = Math.ceil(left/1000), mm = Math.floor(s/60), ss = s%60;
      txt.textContent = mm ? (mm + ":" + pad2(ss)) : (s + "s");
      if (left>0) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      else el.classList.add("done");
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  function scanAndStart(){
    var bars = document.querySelectorAll(".tbar");
    for (var i=0;i<bars.length;i++) startTimerOn(bars[i]);
  }
  // Run now (script is after .tbar HTML)
  scanAndStart();
  // Also run whenever Anki swaps/rebuilds the DOM
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){ scanAndStart(); });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      scanAndStart();
    });
  }
})();

(function(){
  function isIPhone(){
    return document.documentElement.classList.contains("iphone") ||
           (document.body && document.body.classList.contains("iphone"));
  }
  if (!isIPhone()) return;
  function playIPhoneAudioOnce(){
    var btn = document.querySelector(".replay-button, .replaybutton, .soundLink");
    if (!btn || btn.dataset.iphoneAutoplayDone) return;
    btn.dataset.iphoneAutoplayDone = "1";
    btn.click();
  }
  playIPhoneAudioOnce();
  setTimeout(playIPhoneAudioOnce, 50);
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){
    playIPhoneAudioOnce();
  });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      playIPhoneAudioOnce();
    });
  }
})();

(function(){
  function isIOSClient(){
    var htmlCls = (document.documentElement && document.documentElement.className) || "";
    var bodyCls = (document.body && document.body.className) || "";
    var cls = (htmlCls + " " + bodyCls).toLowerCase();
    return /\biphone\b|\bipad\b/.test(cls);
  }
  if (!isIOSClient()) return;
  function colorFor(p){
    var hStart = 170, hEnd = 0, h = hEnd + (hStart - hEnd) * p;
    return "hsl(" + h + ",95%,55%)";
  }
  function pad2(n){ return (n<10 ? "0" : "") + n; }
  function startTimerOn(el){
    if (!el || el.hasAttribute("data-bar-started")) return;
    el.setAttribute("data-bar-started","1");
    var secs = parseFloat(el.getAttribute("data-seconds") || "12");
    if (!(secs > 0)) secs = 1;
    var fill = el.querySelector(".tfill");
    var txt = el.querySelector(".tleft");
    if (!fill || !txt) return;
    var durMs = secs * 1000;
    var start = performance.now();
    function tick(t){
      var left = Math.max(0, durMs - (t - start));
      var frac = left / durMs;
      fill.style.width = (frac * 100).toFixed(3) + "%";
      fill.style.background = colorFor(frac);
      var s = Math.ceil(left / 1000);
      var mm = Math.floor(s / 60);
      var ss = s % 60;
      txt.textContent = mm ? (mm + ":" + pad2(ss)) : (s + "s");
      if (left > 0) {
        requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      } else {
        el.classList.add("done");
      }
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  function scanAndStart(){
    var bars = document.querySelectorAll(".tbar");
    for (var i = 0; i < bars.length; i++) startTimerOn(bars[i]);
  }
  scanAndStart();
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){
    scanAndStart();
  });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      scanAndStart();
    });
  }
})();

(function(){
  function isIPhone(){
    return document.documentElement.classList.contains("iphone") ||
           (document.body && document.body.classList.contains("iphone"));
  }
  if (!isIPhone()) return;
  function playIPhoneAudioOnce(){
    var btn = document.querySelector(".replay-button, .replaybutton, .soundLink");
    if (!btn || btn.dataset.iphoneAutoplayDone) return;
    btn.dataset.iphoneAutoplayDone = "1";
    btn.click();
  }
  playIPhoneAudioOnce();
  setTimeout(playIPhoneAudioOnce, 50);
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){
    playIPhoneAudioOnce();
  });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      playIPhoneAudioOnce();
    });
  }
})();

try {
  const src = document.getElementById('images-src');
  const images = src ? src.children : [];
  let randomIdx = Math.floor(Math.random() * (images.length || 1));
  function show_img(){
    const holder = document.getElementById('front');
    if (!holder || images.length === 0) return;
    holder.innerHTML = images[randomIdx].outerHTML;
  }
  function next_img(){
    if (images.length <= 1) return;
    randomIdx = (randomIdx + 1) % images.length;
    show_img();
  }
  // Hide the button if there's only one image
  if (images.length <= 1) {
    const btn = document.getElementById('btn');
    if (btn) btn.style.display = 'none';
  }
  show_img();
  // Add the key listener once per card render
  if (!document.body.hasAttribute('img-rand-listener')) {
    document.addEventListener('keyup', function(event){
      const k = event.key || event.keyCode;
      if (k === 'n' || k === 'N') next_img();
    });
    document.body.setAttribute('img-rand-listener', 'true');
  }
} catch (error) {
  const c = document.getElementById('console');
  if (c) c.textContent = error;
}

/* Re-entrant bar timer for Anki (desktop, AnkiMobile, AnkiDroid)
   - Attaches on every card load (no global guard)
   - Starts once per element via data flag
   - Works even when Anki swaps DOM without reloading the page
*/
(function(){
  function isIPhone(){
    return document.documentElement.classList.contains("iphone") ||
           (document.body && document.body.classList.contains("iphone"));
  }
  if (!isIPhone()) return;
  function colorFor(p){
    var hStart = 170, hEnd = 0, h = hEnd + (hStart - hEnd) * p;
    return "hsl(" + h + ",95%,55%)";
  }
  function pad2(n){ return (n<10? "0":"") + n }
  function startTimerOn(el){
    if (!el || el.hasAttribute("data-bar-started")) return;
    el.setAttribute("data-bar-started","1");
    var secs = parseFloat(el.getAttribute("data-seconds")||"12");
    if (!(secs>0)) secs = 1;
    var fill  = el.querySelector(".tfill");
    var txt   = el.querySelector(".tleft");
    if (!fill || !txt) return;
    var durMs = secs*1000, start = performance.now();
    function tick(t){
      var left = Math.max(0, durMs - (t - start));
      var frac = left / durMs;
      fill.style.width = (frac*100).toFixed(3) + "%";
      fill.style.background = colorFor(frac);
      var s = Math.ceil(left/1000), mm = Math.floor(s/60), ss = s%60;
      txt.textContent = mm ? (mm + ":" + pad2(ss)) : (s + "s");
      if (left>0) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      else el.classList.add("done");
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  function scanAndStart(){
    var bars = document.querySelectorAll(".tbar");
    for (var i=0;i<bars.length;i++) startTimerOn(bars[i]);
  }
  // Run now (script is after .tbar HTML)
  scanAndStart();
  // Also run whenever Anki swaps/rebuilds the DOM
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){ scanAndStart(); });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      scanAndStart();
    });
  }
})();

(function(){
  function isIPhone(){
    return document.documentElement.classList.contains("iphone") ||
           (document.body && document.body.classList.contains("iphone"));
  }
  if (!isIPhone()) return;
  function playIPhoneAudioOnce(){
    var btn = document.querySelector(".replay-button, .replaybutton, .soundLink");
    if (!btn || btn.dataset.iphoneAutoplayDone) return;
    btn.dataset.iphoneAutoplayDone = "1";
    btn.click();
  }
  playIPhoneAudioOnce();
  setTimeout(playIPhoneAudioOnce, 50);
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){
    playIPhoneAudioOnce();
  });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      playIPhoneAudioOnce();
    });
  }
})();

    return /\biphone\b|\bipad\b/.test(cls);
  }
  if (!isIOSClient()) return;
  function colorFor(p){
    var hStart = 170, hEnd = 0, h = hEnd + (hStart - hEnd) * p;
    return "hsl(" + h + ",95%,55%)";
  }
  function pad2(n){ return (n<10 ? "0" : "") + n; }
  function startTimerOn(el){
    if (!el || el.hasAttribute("data-bar-started")) return;
    el.setAttribute("data-bar-started","1");
    var secs = parseFloat(el.getAttribute("data-seconds") || "12");
    if (!(secs > 0)) secs = 1;
    var fill = el.querySelector(".tfill");
    var txt = el.querySelector(".tleft");
    if (!fill || !txt) return;
    var durMs = secs * 1000;
    var start = performance.now();

      var frac = left / durMs;
      fill.style.width = (frac * 100).toFixed(3) + "%";
      fill.style.background = colorFor(frac);
      var s = Math.ceil(left / 1000);
      var mm = Math.floor(s / 60);
      var ss = s % 60;
      txt.textContent = mm ? (mm + ":" + pad2(ss)) : (s + "s");
      if (left > 0) {
        requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      } else {
        el.classList.add("done");
      }
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

    for (var i = 0; i < bars.length; i++) startTimerOn(bars[i]);
  }

  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){
    scanAndStart();
  });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {

      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      scanAndStart();
    });
  }
})();

function countdown( elementName, minutes, seconds )
{
    var element, endTime, hours, mins, msLeft, time;
    function twoDigits( n )
    {
        return (n <= 9 ? "0" + n : n);
    }
    function updateTimer()
    {
        msLeft = endTime - (+new Date);
        if ( msLeft < 1000 ) {
            element.innerHTML = "<span style='color:#CC5B5B'>TIME</span>";
        } else {
            time = new Date( msLeft );
            hours = time.getUTCHours();
            mins = time.getUTCMinutes();
            element.innerHTML = (hours ? hours + ':' + twoDigits( mins ) : mins) + ':' + twoDigits( time.getUTCSeconds() );
            setTimeout( updateTimer, time.getUTCMilliseconds() + 500 );
        }
    }
    element = document.getElementById( elementName );
    endTime = (+new Date) + 1000 * (60*minutes + seconds) + 500;
    updateTimer();
}
countdown("s2", 0, 10 ); //2nd value is the minute, 3rd is the seconds

            time = new Date( msLeft );
            hours = time.getUTCHours();
            mins = time.getUTCMinutes();
            element.innerHTML = (hours ? hours + ':' + twoDigits( mins ) : mins) + ':' + twoDigits( time.getUTCSeconds() );
            setTimeout( updateTimer, time.getUTCMilliseconds() + 500 );
        }
    }
    element = document.getElementById( elementName );
    endTime = (+new Date) + 1000 * (60*minutes + seconds) + 500;
    updateTimer();
}
countdown("s2", 0, 10 ); //2nd value is the minute, 3rd is the seconds

/* Re-entrant bar timer for Anki (desktop, AnkiMobile, AnkiDroid)
   - Attaches on every card load (no global guard)
   - Starts once per element via data flag
   - Works even when Anki swaps DOM without reloading the page
*/
(function(){
  function isIPhone(){
    return document.documentElement.classList.contains("iphone") ||
           (document.body && document.body.classList.contains("iphone"));
  }
  if (!isIPhone()) return;
  function colorFor(p){
    var hStart = 170, hEnd = 0, h = hEnd + (hStart - hEnd) * p;
    return "hsl(" + h + ",95%,55%)";
  }
  function pad2(n){ return (n<10? "0":"") + n }
  function startTimerOn(el){
    if (!el || el.hasAttribute("data-bar-started")) return;
    el.setAttribute("data-bar-started","1");
    var secs = parseFloat(el.getAttribute("data-seconds")||"12");
    if (!(secs>0)) secs = 1;
    var fill  = el.querySelector(".tfill");
    var txt   = el.querySelector(".tleft");
    if (!fill || !txt) return;
    var durMs = secs*1000, start = performance.now();
    function tick(t){
      var left = Math.max(0, durMs - (t - start));
      var frac = left / durMs;
      fill.style.width = (frac*100).toFixed(3) + "%";
      fill.style.background = colorFor(frac);
      var s = Math.ceil(left/1000), mm = Math.floor(s/60), ss = s%60;
      txt.textContent = mm ? (mm + ":" + pad2(ss)) : (s + "s");
      if (left>0) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      else el.classList.add("done");
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  function scanAndStart(){
    var bars = document.querySelectorAll(".tbar");
    for (var i=0;i<bars.length;i++) startTimerOn(bars[i]);
  }
  // Run now (script is after .tbar HTML)
  scanAndStart();
  // Also run whenever Anki swaps/rebuilds the DOM
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){ scanAndStart(); });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      scanAndStart();
    });
  }
})();

(function(){
  function isIPhone(){
    return document.documentElement.classList.contains("iphone") ||
           (document.body && document.body.classList.contains("iphone"));
  }
  if (!isIPhone()) return;
  function playIPhoneAudioOnce(){
    var btn = document.querySelector(".replay-button, .replaybutton, .soundLink");
    if (!btn || btn.dataset.iphoneAutoplayDone) return;
    btn.dataset.iphoneAutoplayDone = "1";
    btn.click();
  }
  playIPhoneAudioOnce();
  setTimeout(playIPhoneAudioOnce, 50);
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){
    playIPhoneAudioOnce();
  });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      playIPhoneAudioOnce();
    });
  }
})();

[...]
/* Re-entrant bar timer for Anki (desktop, AnkiMobile, AnkiDroid)
   - Attaches on every card load (no global guard)
   - Starts once per element via data flag
   - Works even when Anki swaps DOM without reloading the page
*/
(function(){
  function isIPhone(){
    return document.documentElement.classList.contains("iphone") ||
           (document.body && document.body.classList.contains("iphone"));
  }
  if (!isIPhone()) return;
  function colorFor(p){
    var hStart = 170, hEnd = 0, h = hEnd + (hStart - hEnd) * p;
    return "hsl(" + h + ",95%,55%)";
  }
  function pad2(n){ return (n<10? "0":"") + n }
  function startTimerOn(el){
    if (!el || el.hasAttribute("data-bar-started")) return;
    el.setAttribute("data-bar-started","1");
    var secs = parseFloat(el.getAttribute("data-seconds")||"12");
    if (!(secs>0)) secs = 1;
    var fill  = el.querySelector(".tfill");
    var txt   = el.querySelector(".tleft");
    if (!fill || !txt) return;
    var durMs = secs*1000, start = performance.now();
    function tick(t){
      var left = Math.max(0, durMs - (t - start));
      var frac = left / durMs;
      fill.style.width = (frac*100).toFixed(3) + "%";
      fill.style.background = colorFor(frac);
      var s = Math.ceil(left/1000), mm = Math.floor(s/60), ss = s%60;
      txt.textContent = mm ? (mm + ":" + pad2(ss)) : (s + "s");
      if (left>0) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      else el.classList.add("done");
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  function scanAndStart(){
    var bars = document.querySelectorAll(".tbar");
    for (var i=0;i<bars.length;i++) startTimerOn(bars[i]);
  }
  // Run now (script is after .tbar HTML)
  scanAndStart();
  // Also run whenever Anki swaps/rebuilds the DOM
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){ scanAndStart(); });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      scanAndStart();
    });
  }
})();

Under the Privacy Rule, safe harbor refers to the removal of 18 specified individual identifiers as well as making sure the covered entity does not actually know that the remaining information could still identify someone, either by itself or when combined with other information.
(function(){
  function isIOSClient(){
    var htmlCls = (document.documentElement && document.documentElement.className) || "";
    var bodyCls = (document.body && document.body.className) || "";
    var cls = (htmlCls + " " + bodyCls).toLowerCase();
    return /\biphone\b|\bipad\b/.test(cls);
  }
  if (!isIOSClient()) return;
  function colorFor(p){
    var hStart = 170, hEnd = 0, h = hEnd + (hStart - hEnd) * p;
    return "hsl(" + h + ",95%,55%)";
  }
  function pad2(n){ return (n<10 ? "0" : "") + n; }
  function startTimerOn(el){
    if (!el || el.hasAttribute("data-bar-started")) return;
    el.setAttribute("data-bar-started","1");
    var secs = parseFloat(el.getAttribute("data-seconds") || "12");
    if (!(secs > 0)) secs = 1;
    var fill = el.querySelector(".tfill");
    var txt = el.querySelector(".tleft");
    if (!fill || !txt) return;
    var durMs = secs * 1000;
    var start = performance.now();
    function tick(t){
      var left = Math.max(0, durMs - (t - start));
      var frac = left / durMs;
      fill.style.width = (frac * 100).toFixed(3) + "%";
      fill.style.background = colorFor(frac);
      var s = Math.ceil(left / 1000);
      var mm = Math.floor(s / 60);
      var ss = s % 60;
      txt.textContent = mm ? (mm + ":" + pad2(ss)) : (s + "s");
      if (left > 0) {
        requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      } else {
        el.classList.add("done");
      }
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  function scanAndStart(){
    var bars = document.querySelectorAll(".tbar");
    for (var i = 0; i < bars.length; i++) startTimerOn(bars[i]);
  }
  scanAndStart();
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){
    scanAndStart();
  });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      scanAndStart();
    });
  }
})();

(function(){
  function isIPhone(){
    return document.documentElement.classList.contains("iphone") ||
           (document.body && document.body.classList.contains("iphone"));
  }
  if (!isIPhone()) return;
  function playIPhoneAudioOnce(){
    var btn = document.querySelector(".replay-button, .replaybutton, .soundLink");
    if (!btn || btn.dataset.iphoneAutoplayDone) return;
    btn.dataset.iphoneAutoplayDone = "1";
    btn.click();
  }
  playIPhoneAudioOnce();
  setTimeout(playIPhoneAudioOnce, 50);
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){
    playIPhoneAudioOnce();
  });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      playIPhoneAudioOnce();
    });
  }
})();

[...]
/* Re-entrant bar timer for Anki (desktop, AnkiMobile, AnkiDroid)
   - Attaches on every card load (no global guard)
   - Starts once per element via data flag
   - Works even when Anki swaps DOM without reloading the page
*/
(function(){
  function isIPhone(){
    return document.documentElement.classList.contains("iphone") ||
           (document.body && document.body.classList.contains("iphone"));
  }
  if (!isIPhone()) return;
  function colorFor(p){
    var hStart = 170, hEnd = 0, h = hEnd + (hStart - hEnd) * p;
    return "hsl(" + h + ",95%,55%)";
  }
  function pad2(n){ return (n<10? "0":"") + n }
  function startTimerOn(el){
    if (!el || el.hasAttribute("data-bar-started")) return;
    el.setAttribute("data-bar-started","1");
    var secs = parseFloat(el.getAttribute("data-seconds")||"12");
    if (!(secs>0)) secs = 1;
    var fill  = el.querySelector(".tfill");
    var txt   = el.querySelector(".tleft");
    if (!fill || !txt) return;
    var durMs = secs*1000, start = performance.now();
    function tick(t){
      var left = Math.max(0, durMs - (t - start));
      var frac = left / durMs;
      fill.style.width = (frac*100).toFixed(3) + "%";
      fill.style.background = colorFor(frac);
      var s = Math.ceil(left/1000), mm = Math.floor(s/60), ss = s%60;
      txt.textContent = mm ? (mm + ":" + pad2(ss)) : (s + "s");
      if (left>0) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      else el.classList.add("done");
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  function scanAndStart(){
    var bars = document.querySelectorAll(".tbar");
    for (var i=0;i<bars.length;i++) startTimerOn(bars[i]);
  }
  // Run now (script is after .tbar HTML)
  scanAndStart();
  // Also run whenever Anki swaps/rebuilds the DOM
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){ scanAndStart(); });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      scanAndStart();
    });
  }
})();

/* Re-entrant bar timer for Anki (desktop, AnkiMobile, AnkiDroid)
   - Attaches on every card load (no global guard)
   - Starts once per element via data flag
   - Works even when Anki swaps DOM without reloading the page
*/
(function(){
  function isIPhone(){
    return document.documentElement.classList.contains("iphone") ||
           (document.body && document.body.classList.contains("iphone"));
  }
  if (!isIPhone()) return;
  function colorFor(p){
    var hStart = 170, hEnd = 0, h = hEnd + (hStart - hEnd) * p;
    return "hsl(" + h + ",95%,55%)";
  }
  function pad2(n){ return (n<10? "0":"") + n }
  function startTimerOn(el){
    if (!el || el.hasAttribute("data-bar-started")) return;
    el.setAttribute("data-bar-started","1");
    var secs = parseFloat(el.getAttribute("data-seconds")||"12");
    if (!(secs>0)) secs = 1;
    var fill  = el.querySelector(".tfill");
    var txt   = el.querySelector(".tleft");
    if (!fill || !txt) return;
    var durMs = secs*1000, start = performance.now();
    function tick(t){
      var left = Math.max(0, durMs - (t - start));
      var frac = left / durMs;
      fill.style.width = (frac*100).toFixed(3) + "%";
      fill.style.background = colorFor(frac);
      var s = Math.ceil(left/1000), mm = Math.floor(s/60), ss = s%60;
      txt.textContent = mm ? (mm + ":" + pad2(ss)) : (s + "s");
      if (left>0) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      else el.classList.add("done");
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  function scanAndStart(){
    var bars = document.querySelectorAll(".tbar");
    for (var i=0;i<bars.length;i++) startTimerOn(bars[i]);
  }
  // Run now (script is after .tbar HTML)
  scanAndStart();
  // Also run whenever Anki swaps/rebuilds the DOM
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){ scanAndStart(); });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      scanAndStart();
    });
  }
})();

(function(){
  function isIPhone(){
    return document.documentElement.classList.contains("iphone") ||
           (document.body && document.body.classList.contains("iphone"));
  }
  if (!isIPhone()) return;
  function playIPhoneAudioOnce(){
    var btn = document.querySelector(".replay-button, .replaybutton, .soundLink");
    if (!btn || btn.dataset.iphoneAutoplayDone) return;
    btn.dataset.iphoneAutoplayDone = "1";
    btn.click();
  }
  playIPhoneAudioOnce();
  setTimeout(playIPhoneAudioOnce, 50);
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){
    playIPhoneAudioOnce();
  });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      playIPhoneAudioOnce();
    });
  }
})();

/* Re-entrant bar timer for Anki (desktop, AnkiMobile, AnkiDroid)
   - Attaches on every card load (no global guard)
   - Starts once per element via data flag
   - Works even when Anki swaps DOM without reloading the page
*/
(function(){
  function isIPhone(){
    return document.documentElement.classList.contains("iphone") ||
           (document.body && document.body.classList.contains("iphone"));
  }
  if (!isIPhone()) return;
  function colorFor(p){
    var hStart = 170, hEnd = 0, h = hEnd + (hStart - hEnd) * p;
    return "hsl(" + h + ",95%,55%)";
  }
  function pad2(n){ return (n<10? "0":"") + n }
  function startTimerOn(el){
    if (!el || el.hasAttribute("data-bar-started")) return;
    el.setAttribute("data-bar-started","1");
    var secs = parseFloat(el.getAttribute("data-seconds")||"12");
    if (!(secs>0)) secs = 1;
    var fill  = el.querySelector(".tfill");
    var txt   = el.querySelector(".tleft");
    if (!fill || !txt) return;
    var durMs = secs*1000, start = performance.now();
    function tick(t){
      var left = Math.max(0, durMs - (t - start));
      var frac = left / durMs;
      fill.style.width = (frac*100).toFixed(3) + "%";
      fill.style.background = colorFor(frac);
      var s = Math.ceil(left/1000), mm = Math.floor(s/60), ss = s%60;
      txt.textContent = mm ? (mm + ":" + pad2(ss)) : (s + "s");
      if (left>0) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      else el.classList.add("done");
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  function scanAndStart(){
    var bars = document.querySelectorAll(".tbar");
    for (var i=0;i<bars.length;i++) startTimerOn(bars[i]);
  }
  // Run now (script is after .tbar HTML)
  scanAndStart();
  // Also run whenever Anki swaps/rebuilds the DOM
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){ scanAndStart(); });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      scanAndStart();
    });
  }
})();

  function isIOSClient(){

    var bodyCls = (document.body && document.body.className) || "";
    var cls = (htmlCls + " " + bodyCls).toLowerCase();
    return /\biphone\b|\bipad\b/.test(cls);
  }
  if (!isIOSClient()) return;
  function colorFor(p){
    var hStart = 170, hEnd = 0, h = hEnd + (hStart - hEnd) * p;
    return "hsl(" + h + ",95%,55%)";
  }
  function pad2(n){ return (n<10 ? "0" : "") + n; }
  function startTimerOn(el){
    if (!el || el.hasAttribute("data-bar-started")) return;
    el.setAttribute("data-bar-started","1");
    var secs = parseFloat(el.getAttribute("data-seconds") || "12");
    if (!(secs > 0)) secs = 1;
    var fill = el.querySelector(".tfill");
    var txt = el.querySelector(".tleft");
    if (!fill || !txt) return;
    var durMs = secs * 1000;
    var start = performance.now();
    function tick(t){
      var left = Math.max(0, durMs - (t - start));
      var frac = left / durMs;
      fill.style.width = (frac * 100).toFixed(3) + "%";
      fill.style.background = colorFor(frac);
      var s = Math.ceil(left / 1000);
      var mm = Math.floor(s / 60);
      var ss = s % 60;
      txt.textContent = mm ? (mm + ":" + pad2(ss)) : (s + "s");
      if (left > 0) {
        requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      } else {
        el.classList.add("done");
      }
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  function scanAndStart(){
    var bars = document.querySelectorAll(".tbar");
    for (var i = 0; i < bars.length; i++) startTimerOn(bars[i]);
  }
  scanAndStart();
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){
    scanAndStart();
  });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      scanAndStart();
    });
  }
})();

/* Re-entrant bar timer for Anki (desktop, AnkiMobile, AnkiDroid)
   - Attaches on every card load (no global guard)
   - Starts once per element via data flag
   - Works even when Anki swaps DOM without reloading the page
*/
(function(){
  function isIPhone(){
    return document.documentElement.classList.contains("iphone") ||
           (document.body && document.body.classList.contains("iphone"));
  }
  if (!isIPhone()) return;
  function colorFor(p){
    var hStart = 170, hEnd = 0, h = hEnd + (hStart - hEnd) * p;
    return "hsl(" + h + ",95%,55%)";
  }
  function pad2(n){ return (n<10? "0":"") + n }
  function startTimerOn(el){
    if (!el || el.hasAttribute("data-bar-started")) return;
    el.setAttribute("data-bar-started","1");
    var secs = parseFloat(el.getAttribute("data-seconds")||"12");
    if (!(secs>0)) secs = 1;
    var fill  = el.querySelector(".tfill");
    var txt   = el.querySelector(".tleft");
    if (!fill || !txt) return;
    var durMs = secs*1000, start = performance.now();
    function tick(t){
      var left = Math.max(0, durMs - (t - start));
      var frac = left / durMs;
      fill.style.width = (frac*100).toFixed(3) + "%";
      fill.style.background = colorFor(frac);
      var s = Math.ceil(left/1000), mm = Math.floor(s/60), ss = s%60;
      txt.textContent = mm ? (mm + ":" + pad2(ss)) : (s + "s");
      if (left>0) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      else el.classList.add("done");
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  function scanAndStart(){
    var bars = document.querySelectorAll(".tbar");
    for (var i=0;i<bars.length;i++) startTimerOn(bars[i]);
  }
  // Run now (script is after .tbar HTML)
  scanAndStart();
  // Also run whenever Anki swaps/rebuilds the DOM
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){ scanAndStart(); });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      scanAndStart();
    });
  }
})();

(function(){
  function isIPhone(){
    return document.documentElement.classList.contains("iphone") ||
           (document.body && document.body.classList.contains("iphone"));
  }
  if (!isIPhone()) return;
  function playIPhoneAudioOnce(){
    var btn = document.querySelector(".replay-button, .replaybutton, .soundLink");
    if (!btn || btn.dataset.iphoneAutoplayDone) return;
    btn.dataset.iphoneAutoplayDone = "1";
    btn.click();
  }
  playIPhoneAudioOnce();
  setTimeout(playIPhoneAudioOnce, 50);
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){
    playIPhoneAudioOnce();
  });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      playIPhoneAudioOnce();
    });
  }
})();

/* Re-entrant bar timer for Anki (desktop, AnkiMobile, AnkiDroid)
   - Attaches on every card load (no global guard)
   - Starts once per element via data flag
   - Works even when Anki swaps DOM without reloading the page
*/
(function(){
  function isIPhone(){
    return document.documentElement.classList.contains("iphone") ||
           (document.body && document.body.classList.contains("iphone"));
  }
  if (!isIPhone()) return;
  function colorFor(p){
    var hStart = 170, hEnd = 0, h = hEnd + (hStart - hEnd) * p;
    return "hsl(" + h + ",95%,55%)";
  }
  function pad2(n){ return (n<10? "0":"") + n }
  function startTimerOn(el){
    if (!el || el.hasAttribute("data-bar-started")) return;
    el.setAttribute("data-bar-started","1");
    var secs = parseFloat(el.getAttribute("data-seconds")||"12");
    if (!(secs>0)) secs = 1;
    var fill  = el.querySelector(".tfill");
    var txt   = el.querySelector(".tleft");
    if (!fill || !txt) return;
    var durMs = secs*1000, start = performance.now();
    function tick(t){
      var left = Math.max(0, durMs - (t - start));
      var frac = left / durMs;
      fill.style.width = (frac*100).toFixed(3) + "%";
      fill.style.background = colorFor(frac);
      var s = Math.ceil(left/1000), mm = Math.floor(s/60), ss = s%60;
      txt.textContent = mm ? (mm + ":" + pad2(ss)) : (s + "s");
      if (left>0) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      else el.classList.add("done");
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  function scanAndStart(){
    var bars = document.querySelectorAll(".tbar");
    for (var i=0;i<bars.length;i++) startTimerOn(bars[i]);
  }
  // Run now (script is after .tbar HTML)
  scanAndStart();
  // Also run whenever Anki swaps/rebuilds the DOM
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){ scanAndStart(); });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      scanAndStart();
    });
  }
})();

/* Re-entrant bar timer for Anki (desktop, AnkiMobile, AnkiDroid)
   - Attaches on every card load (no global guard)
   - Starts once per element via data flag
   - Works even when Anki swaps DOM without reloading the page
*/
(function(){
  function isIPhone(){
    return document.documentElement.classList.contains("iphone") ||
           (document.body && document.body.classList.contains("iphone"));
  }
  if (!isIPhone()) return;
  function colorFor(p){
    var hStart = 170, hEnd = 0, h = hEnd + (hStart - hEnd) * p;
    return "hsl(" + h + ",95%,55%)";
  }
  function pad2(n){ return (n<10? "0":"") + n }
  function startTimerOn(el){
    if (!el || el.hasAttribute("data-bar-started")) return;
    el.setAttribute("data-bar-started","1");
    var secs = parseFloat(el.getAttribute("data-seconds")||"12");
    if (!(secs>0)) secs = 1;
    var fill  = el.querySelector(".tfill");
    var txt   = el.querySelector(".tleft");
    if (!fill || !txt) return;
    var durMs = secs*1000, start = performance.now();
    function tick(t){
      var left = Math.max(0, durMs - (t - start));
      var frac = left / durMs;
      fill.style.width = (frac*100).toFixed(3) + "%";
      fill.style.background = colorFor(frac);
      var s = Math.ceil(left/1000), mm = Math.floor(s/60), ss = s%60;
      txt.textContent = mm ? (mm + ":" + pad2(ss)) : (s + "s");
      if (left>0) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      else el.classList.add("done");
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  function scanAndStart(){
    var bars = document.querySelectorAll(".tbar");
    for (var i=0;i<bars.length;i++) startTimerOn(bars[i]);
  }
  // Run now (script is after .tbar HTML)
  scanAndStart();
  // Also run whenever Anki swaps/rebuilds the DOM
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){ scanAndStart(); });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      scanAndStart();
    });
  }
})();

(function(){
  function isIPhone(){
    return document.documentElement.classList.contains("iphone") ||
           (document.body && document.body.classList.contains("iphone"));
  }
  if (!isIPhone()) return;
  function playIPhoneAudioOnce(){
    var btn = document.querySelector(".replay-button, .replaybutton, .soundLink");
    if (!btn || btn.dataset.iphoneAutoplayDone) return;
    btn.dataset.iphoneAutoplayDone = "1";
    btn.click();
  }
  playIPhoneAudioOnce();
  setTimeout(playIPhoneAudioOnce, 50);
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){
    playIPhoneAudioOnce();
  });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      playIPhoneAudioOnce();
    });
  }
})();

/* Re-entrant bar timer for Anki (desktop, AnkiMobile, AnkiDroid)
   - Attaches on every card load (no global guard)
   - Starts once per element via data flag
   - Works even when Anki swaps DOM without reloading the page
*/
(function(){
  function isIPhone(){
    return document.documentElement.classList.contains("iphone") ||
           (document.body && document.body.classList.contains("iphone"));
  }
  if (!isIPhone()) return;
  function colorFor(p){
    var hStart = 170, hEnd = 0, h = hEnd + (hStart - hEnd) * p;
    return "hsl(" + h + ",95%,55%)";
  }
  function pad2(n){ return (n<10? "0":"") + n }
  function startTimerOn(el){
    if (!el || el.hasAttribute("data-bar-started")) return;
    el.setAttribute("data-bar-started","1");
    var secs = parseFloat(el.getAttribute("data-seconds")||"12");
    if (!(secs>0)) secs = 1;
    var fill  = el.querySelector(".tfill");
    var txt   = el.querySelector(".tleft");
    if (!fill || !txt) return;
    var durMs = secs*1000, start = performance.now();
    function tick(t){
      var left = Math.max(0, durMs - (t - start));
      var frac = left / durMs;
      fill.style.width = (frac*100).toFixed(3) + "%";
      fill.style.background = colorFor(frac);
      var s = Math.ceil(left/1000), mm = Math.floor(s/60), ss = s%60;
      txt.textContent = mm ? (mm + ":" + pad2(ss)) : (s + "s");
      if (left>0) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      else el.classList.add("done");
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  function scanAndStart(){
    var bars = document.querySelectorAll(".tbar");
    for (var i=0;i<bars.length;i++) startTimerOn(bars[i]);
  }
  // Run now (script is after .tbar HTML)
  scanAndStart();
  // Also run whenever Anki swaps/rebuilds the DOM
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){ scanAndStart(); });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      scanAndStart();
    });
  }
})();

    var htmlCls = (document.documentElement && document.documentElement.className) || "";
    var bodyCls = (document.body && document.body.className) || "";
    var cls = (htmlCls + " " + bodyCls).toLowerCase();
    return /\biphone\b|\bipad\b/.test(cls);
  }
  if (!isIOSClient()) return;
  function colorFor(p){
    var hStart = 170, hEnd = 0, h = hEnd + (hStart - hEnd) * p;
    return "hsl(" + h + ",95%,55%)";
  }
  function pad2(n){ return (n<10 ? "0" : "") + n; }
  function startTimerOn(el){
    if (!el || el.hasAttribute("data-bar-started")) return;
    el.setAttribute("data-bar-started","1");
    var secs = parseFloat(el.getAttribute("data-seconds") || "12");
    if (!(secs > 0)) secs = 1;
    var fill = el.querySelector(".tfill");
    var txt = el.querySelector(".tleft");
    if (!fill || !txt) return;
    var durMs = secs * 1000;
    var start = performance.now();
    function tick(t){
      var left = Math.max(0, durMs - (t - start));
      var frac = left / durMs;
      fill.style.width = (frac * 100).toFixed(3) + "%";
      fill.style.background = colorFor(frac);
      var s = Math.ceil(left / 1000);
      var mm = Math.floor(s / 60);
      var ss = s % 60;
      txt.textContent = mm ? (mm + ":" + pad2(ss)) : (s + "s");
      if (left > 0) {
        requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      } else {
        el.classList.add("done");
      }
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  function scanAndStart(){
    var bars = document.querySelectorAll(".tbar");
    for (var i = 0; i < bars.length; i++) startTimerOn(bars[i]);
  }
  scanAndStart();
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){
    scanAndStart();
  });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      scanAndStart();
    });
  }
})();

  }

    return "hsl(" + h + ",95%,55%)";
  }

    if (!el || el.hasAttribute("data-bar-started")) return;

    var secs = parseFloat(el.getAttribute("data-seconds")||"12");
    if (!(secs>0)) secs = 1;
    var fill  = el.querySelector(".tfill");
    var txt   = el.querySelector(".tleft");
    if (!fill || !txt) return;
    var durMs = secs*1000, start = performance.now();
    function tick(t){
      var left = Math.max(0, durMs - (t - start));
      var frac = left / durMs;
      fill.style.width = (frac*100).toFixed(3) + "%";
      fill.style.background = colorFor(frac);
      var s = Math.ceil(left/1000), mm = Math.floor(s/60), ss = s%60;
      txt.textContent = mm ? (mm + ":" + pad2(ss)) : (s + "s");
      if (left>0) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      else el.classList.add("done");
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  function scanAndStart(){
    var bars = document.querySelectorAll(".tbar");
    for (var i=0;i<bars.length;i++) startTimerOn(bars[i]);
  }
  // Run now (script is after .tbar HTML)
  scanAndStart();
  // Also run whenever Anki swaps/rebuilds the DOM
  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){ scanAndStart(); });
  if (document.body){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      scanAndStart();
    });
  }
})();
